_source: Recorded-shape fixtures written from Perplexity's official Search API reference (https://docs.perplexity.ai/api-reference/search-post, read 2026-10-20). Success follows the documented ranked results array with title, url, snippet, date and last_updated; source text is illustrative. Generated answer/choices fields are defensive probes, not documented Search API output. Error bodies are illustrative, never live credentials or queries. HTTP statuses exercise the shared outcome rows; local transmission states are tested separately. Capability skips use direct preparation because the full valid tool envelope fits this API.
